reviews.text:
Seems to be business first , pets welfare secondary .
The closing time on a Saturday is 12 :30 pm I rang at around 11:30 , my first question was you have not brought your cat here for two years , have you taken him somewhere else ???? My cat has been perfectly well thankyou so there was no need to bring him !!!
What’s wrong with your cat ?
He’s under the weather , I have de wormed him , he’s been very lethargic for a couple of days and he’s off his food, he hasn’t been sick or had diahrea  . Ok you can bring him in now but it’s now out of hours so you will have to pay out of hours fees . I thought it’s still before 12 and you close at 12:30 but ok , I’m worried about my cat .
The vet checked him over , said he had a temperature , a bit of conjunctivitis but because of his temp his organs can shut down , he could have bloods taken , scans and was looking at me like it was life or death . I told him that he needs antibiotics and I’ll see how he goes , he then offered a medicine that could be risky for his liver , I said no , just antibiotics , he proceeded to give anti biotic and another anti sickness and diarrhoea   Medication even though he wasn’t being sick or pooping . I went in on the following Monday just to see if I could  get the conjunctivitis drops that the vet had asked if I would be able to give him but I’d declined . The frosty nature of the staff was rediculous , one woman said it’s not on the notes , I said ask the vet , they told me he’s in today but he’s not working ??? A 20 second conversation would have answered this !!! Then another member of staff told me they would have to ask another vet and ring me later , they can’t just magic it out of thin air ???? Wow !!! They didn’t ring me later !  I took him to another vets two days later and he was prescribed with ear drops because of the ear infection he had . No organs going to give up on him , no bloods or scans which would cost a fortune , I was told the reaction to the De wormer  was mild as Bob martins dewormer has barely anything in it . Now he’s right as rain . Hopwood just after as much as they can fleece from you !! Townsend vets Bromsgrove / Rubery are pets health first , customer service first! Goodbye hopwood !!!!!!!

So professional.  Kind caring and considerate... Great value and do not over charge or rip you off. Was a true blessing seeing this vets. Very highly recommended. Defo went above and beyond id give them 10 stars if I could thats how good they all are at this vets. Thank you for everything you have done for me and my son bandit  🙏 …

The reception lady is the rudest woman i’ve ever come across the way she speaks on the phone and in person makes me feel so uncomfortable to even be there. it’s a shame to be honest because everyone else is lovely just the reception lady lets the place down
Have been taking my neurotic cat here for several years,  and all the staff have been extremely caring and understanding of her needs.
Did not help a poorly stray kitten unless someone paid the full consultation and treatment amount. Not true animal lovers

Well if what I'm reading about this vets is true,about a stray being taken to you  for scanning& you didn't even check the poor cat over.   You should be ashamed!!...I don't call that care.....went getting paid though  were you!....shamefull
Been with this practice for years..always a good and efficient service A++
Lovely little vet surgery with friendly staff. Obviously care very much about the pets they look after.
Been using Hopwood vets for nearly 6 years now for my boy Charlie -Boris. They’ve always been brilliant with him,  from  reception staff to the vet . Will always recommend them to anyone .

I cannot thank everyone at Hopwood Veterinary Centre enough for the care, kindness, and compassion they showed when we had to say goodbye to our beloved dog, Poppy. From the moment we arrived, the staff were exceptional, gentle, patient, and truly understanding of how heartbreaking the situation was.

They treated Poppy with dignity and love, and they treated us with genuine empathy and respect, giving us the time and space we needed without ever feeling rushed. Their compassion made one of the hardest moments of our lives a little more bearable, and for that we will always be grateful.

Hopwood Veterinary Centre went above and beyond, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of Poppy and for supporting us with such kindness during such a difficult time. 💔🐾

Discriminatory! Reception staff are unsympathetic and rude. They have no understanding of speaking with disabled customers. It was all apparently my fault that they had no knowledge or any information on how to speak calm and politely to customers,  their excuse being they no training on disabilities, so can't be generally polite. When I then requested that a vet who wasn't treating my pet should not approach me or greet/touch my pets in the reception area (due to him insulting me and causing significant anxiety) - this was not accepted as they think disrespecting mine and my assistance dogs space is acceptable. They gave me 2 week notice to leave, despite having pet plans they claim they can't cancel for 8 months!

Quite glad to be leaving though to be honest as the reception staff have been rude to me on a number of occasions!
Had our max put to sleep today .they was excellent. Helped us through such a tough decision. And so understanding

Great vets and great staff, we had to take our beloved rat into this vets as an emergency and they got us in right away, we will always be greatful for that.

The service was fantastic and the vet we seen was informative, professional and sympathetic with us.

Unfortunately our little rat didn’t make it but the staff made our visit the best and as private as it could’ve been and we are greatful for this.

110% would recommend.

Here’s a little photo of our rat Turk, we miss you big girl. ❤️
amazing vets, looked after my rabbit while she was having her injections would 100% recommend and i will always be putting my pets in this vets
Always friendly staff
Friendly staff

Sorry to have to say  but a vet in hopwood vets made a very bad mistake misdiagnosed my dog  i then took him to willows by which time too late! Then another dog  later  was not even  diagnosed  as being e
nimec until  I went to  a different vet practice never
again  will I use hopwood vet

This is my first time having a pet, and when I emailed to ask for information, the staff were very patient in answering my questions and even helped me register my information. After registering, I could bring my kitten to the clinic to get a microchip in 2 days. The nurse was very gentle and attentive, and it seemed like the kitten didn't feel any pain at all.

I've only been in the UK for 6 months, so I was a bit nervous throughout the process, and my English isn't very good. However, both the customer service staff and the nurse who microchipped my kitten were very friendly. I highly recommend this pet clinic.
Great vets, fantastic professionals and great with the animals
I went with my daughter as she had a problem with her dog and to my eyes she got first class service
Great service from an independent vet practice, friendly and helpful staff, would defo recommend

Outstanding service ! First vet office who does not rip you off ! Great prices and care
Ten out of ten !!!!

Not long moved to the area and registered with this vet. There was a waiting list but I got a call not too long after joining it to register.
Took my dog for his annual booster and had the best experience. He is a rescue dog and previous vets haven't helped his nervousness. They'd want to put his booster in his scruff and even take him away from me to hold him down and do so. I found a vet at the last practice who found a way to do it that worked for him. Marcus (the vet at this surgery) had taken the time to read his notes, acknowledged he was a nervous dog when we went in and went slow with him. Made him feel a big more relaxed before the jabs and took time explaining things to me. It was the least stressed my dog has been at the vets.
He was just the loveliest of vet!!

Cared for my cat Hannah (she was 25) who had to be put to sleep with such compassion and love. Thank you for the way you treated me as well. I feel so much better now I know she is at peace. Special thanks to Liz
Real friendly team at this place.
They care
Brilliant vets, all the staff are friendly and welcoming ☺️ definitely recommend
So kind at the passing of my little cat Molly who was nearly 17. All dealt with professionally and with great sensitivity and care. Thank you.
Been with Hopwood Vets for around 35 years in total and have always been happy with the service provided. Highly recommend them.
Good service and caring staff

I was really nervous about taking my very reactive nervous dog to the vets but they handled and treated by dog so very well.  I was very happy as my dog and myself were not traumatised by the experience. Thank you so very much.
Lovely vet and nurse there, was our first time there with our new frenchie, they really looked after her as she is a nervous dog, thanks again will be back soon with beau x

I've been going here for many years with various cats and have always been more than happy with their friendly attitude and professional expertise.  Took my little cat in today as she wasn't well and Marcus quickly found an abscess that we hadn't seen even though we had been checking her.  Had jabs and by the time we got her home she was looking for food.  Great outcome.
